message: You fill the canister at the Gremlin Fountain. The water is neither warm nor cold. The Gremlin seems to wink.
The rack hisses and cools down. Then every screen in the wing flashes red: ROGUE PROCESS DETECTED.
The Broker opens the envelope, smiles, and hands you a photo. It is a photo of you. Not a good one.
The Reporter reads it live: 'THE PRESIDENT IS OPENING A DOOR. FOR EVERYONE.' Somewhere, the Treasury cheers.
Following the blueprints, you reconnect three cables and one very confusing lever. Lights flicker on.
You slot in the Coordinates Drive. A screen blinks: DESTINATION SET. OUTSIDE.
The Power Cell clicks into place. The chamber starts to hum, then purr.
You feed the Exit Permit into a slot marked PAPERWORK. The chamber stamps it. Approved.
The chamber swallows 20 Scrap Hash and roars to life. Then the old gate stones beside it grind upright, and the doors slam shut: NOBODY LEAVES.
You toss some Scrap Hash into the fountain. Nothing happens. The Gremlin looks unimpressed.
